1.consolidated_definition: inform. Programa de informática que permite charlar con contactos previamente autorizados, más controlable que un chat. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. A las tweens les encanta el baile, el ipod, las fiestas, la moda y el messenger (El Nuevo Día, 31-08-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Programa of informatics that allows chatting with previously authorized contacts, more controllable than a chat. 

Anglicism, often used by tweens who enjoy dancing, the iPod, parties, fashion, and instant messaging (The New Day, 31-08-07)
